scope_limits: Current-package forecast routes. The fitted model SHA and actual per-head columns are recorded on each receipt. Declared policies describe the incumbent, without approving statistical thresholds.
historical_support: NBA, NHL, MLS and CFB preparation emits per-season pre-imputation counts for the deployment cohort. Normalized fields cannot establish provider publication or original-time coverage. Other cohorts and incomplete older packages have unknown support.
freshness: Current packages use the existing package and source TTL, as-of date and no-future-fit checks. Each row binds its cutoff, state, source references and semantic identity. Eligible-history recency may differ from source retrieval recency.

nba.source: Provider final histories; regular-season scope and eligible prior-day embargo

nhl.source: Provider final histories; fitted NHL season scope and eligible prior-day embargo. Contract settlement remains separately scoped.

mls.source: Provider final histories under regulation game scope; independent Poisson goal heads

cfb.source: Pinned FBS/FBS schedule and historical scores; week 1 has a separately registered model and is refused by the current packager. No fitted total.

wnba.source: Earlier season box scores and league aggregates, official-plus-one reconciliation and canonical team mapping

mlb.source: Official regular-season D-1 form, probable pitchers and earlier pitcher logs, or explicitly pinned legacy form and dated starter dispositions

groups.team_form: Home/away scoring for and against use fitted league prior when team absent; observed team state is blended by n/(n+10). All fitted heads.
groups.eligible_rest: Each side without last eligible start receives 14 days. Elapsed days are bounded to 0–14. Does not resolve real travel/last game. All fitted heads.
groups.early_history: Home and away cold flags indicate fewer than ten eligible games. All initial heads.
groups.neutral: Normalized neutral flag enters all initial heads; legacy parser substitutes false when provider field absent. Raw omission unresolved on older packages.
groups.packed_imputer: Each fitted column in each packed logistic/linear/Poisson head is ordered by the feature schema, replaces unavailable values with its own fit-time median, and applies own center, scale and coefficients.
groups.elo_prior: Previously unseen team rating defaults to 1500; existing rating regresses on season transitions. Both heads.
groups.ewma: Absent home or away points-for, points-against and margin state yield None; head-specific median replaces it. Both heads.
groups.cfb_rest: Difference is None if either last game is absent; both fitted heads impute.
groups.schedule_flags: Neutral site and conference-game booleans enter both heads. Provenance of a normalized false requires source readback.
groups.wnba_team_eligibility: Missing team season, fewer than the native minimum games or nonpositive possessions blocks all heads.
groups.wnba_shrinkage: Net rating shrinks by games/(games+SHRINK_G); enters winner, margin and total.
groups.wnba_rest: ET-date rest is capped at five; a one-day interval fires back-to-back. Winner and margin.
groups.wnba_rate_floor: Offensive rebound denominator floors available misses at one in four-factor features; winner and margin.
groups.wnba_league_state: League total and pace aggregates require nonzero eligible game count. Total head only.
groups.starter_profile: V13 substitutes 4.20 ERA, 22 K%, 8.5 BB% and zero starts; shrinks ERA by starts/(starts+8). A prior may reflect unknown identity, thin history or legacy staleness. Separate d_logistic_2f consumes shrunk ERA and team form only.
groups.form_default: V13 falsey team runs for/against fall back to 4.45; audit cannot distinguish every upstream substitution in legacy form.
groups.park_factor: Missing/falsey park values use neutral 1.0 on V13; no park field in d_logistic_2f.
